_: Behaviour chains as data: each a list of clips (web/room/mh_v5/<clip>.glb) played in order, blend = the cross-fade into that clip (s), loop = it repeats until the behaviour ends. rare = a punctuation event: fires occasionally, never twice within minGap seconds. kimodo_g12/chain_joins.py measures every join (the worst bone-angle jump, the hips' jump) and every loop's wrap. links: the joins between chains (from, to, blend).

celebrating.note: the capture rises, claps and sits by itself: played whole with the chair rolled back (boy_mh.js rare())
